entries.source: Enjoy a horse riding experience with an instructor in Alanya with hotel transfer, safety briefing, trial ride, scenic mountain trails and panoramic nature stops.
entries.translation: Enjoy a horse riding experience with an instructor in Alanya with hotel transfer, safety briefing, trial ride, scenic mountain trails and panoramic nature stops.

entries.source: Horse Farm • Mountain Trails • Nature Experience
entries.translation: Horse Farm • Mountain Trails • Nature Experience

entries.source: Enjoy a peaceful horse riding experience with an instructor in Alanya through mountain trails, natural landscapes and panoramic countryside views.
entries.translation: Enjoy a peaceful horse riding experience with an instructor in Alanya through mountain trails, natural landscapes and panoramic countryside views.

entries.source: is a calm nature experience in Alanya for guests who want to discover a different side of the region: mountain trails, fresh air, countryside landscapes and panoramic views.
entries.translation: is a calm nature experience in Alanya for guests who want to discover a different side of the region: mountain trails, fresh air, countryside landscapes and panoramic views.

entries.source: The experience begins with transfer from your hotel or apartment to the horse farm. On arrival, the instructor introduces the route and safety rules, helps with equipment and prepares guests for a short trial ride.
entries.translation: The experience begins with transfer from your hotel or apartment to the horse farm. On arrival, the instructor introduces the route and safety rules, helps with equipment and prepares guests for a short trial ride.

entries.source: The main route follows scenic mountain roads and natural trails. Depending on operational conditions, the program may include countryside viewpoints, peaceful village surroundings and stops for rest and photographs.
entries.translation: The main route follows scenic mountain roads and natural trails. Depending on operational conditions, the program may include countryside viewpoints, peaceful village surroundings and stops for rest and photographs.

entries.source: No previous riding experience is required. Participation and horse selection are confirmed on site according to the guest’s age, height, confidence and the instructor’s safety assessment.
entries.translation: No previous riding experience is required. Participation and horse selection are confirmed on site according to the guest’s age, height, confidence and the instructor’s safety assessment.

entries.source: Morning departures are usually the most comfortable during the warmer months. Exact pickup and return times may vary depending on hotel location, traffic and route conditions.
entries.translation: Morning departures are usually the most comfortable during the warmer months. Exact pickup and return times may vary depending on hotel location, traffic and route conditions.

entries.translation: A relaxed horse-riding experience combining hotel transfer, introduction at the horse farm, safety briefing, a trial ride and a scenic route through the natural landscapes of Alanya.

entries.source: Do I need previous horse riding experience?
entries.translation: Do I need previous horse riding experience?

entries.source: No. A safety briefing and trial ride are provided before the route. The instructor selects a suitable horse according to each guest’s confidence and ability.
entries.translation: No. A safety briefing and trial ride are provided before the route. The instructor selects a suitable horse according to each guest’s confidence and ability.

entries.source: Yes. Pickup and return transfer from your hotel or apartment address are included. The exact pickup time is confirmed after booking.
entries.translation: Yes. Pickup and return transfer from your hotel or apartment address are included. The exact pickup time is confirmed after booking.

entries.source: The times are approximate. Pickup and return may vary depending on hotel location, traffic, group organisation and route conditions.
entries.translation: The times are approximate. Pickup and return may vary depending on hotel location, traffic, group organisation and route conditions.

entries.source: Can a child ride together with an adult?
entries.translation: Can a child ride together with an adult?

entries.source: Only when the horse club and instructor explicitly approve this format before the ride. The decision depends on the selected horse, combined rider suitability, saddle and equipment fit, route conditions and horse welfare. It must not be assumed automatically from the child’s age.
entries.translation: Only when the horse club and instructor explicitly approve this format before the ride. The decision depends on the selected horse, combined rider suitability, saddle and equipment fit, route conditions and horse welfare. It must not be assumed automatically from the child’s age.

entries.source: If a child joins the tour without a parent or legal guardian and is accompanied by relatives, family friends or another third party, official adult supervision or written consent from the child’s parent or legal guardian may be required when completing the horse club’s insurance and participation form before the ride.
entries.translation: If a child joins the tour without a parent or legal guardian and is accompanied by relatives, family friends or another third party, official adult supervision or written consent from the child’s parent or legal guardian may be required when completing the horse club’s insurance and participation form before the ride.

entries.source: What equipment is provided free of charge?
entries.translation: What equipment is provided free of charge?

entries.source: A protective riding helmet is provided for every participant and is mandatory throughout the ride. For children, the helmet is selected according to head size. The saddle and bridle are standard riding equipment and are already fitted to the horse.
entries.translation: A protective riding helmet is provided for every participant and is mandatory throughout the ride. For children, the helmet is selected according to head size. The saddle and bridle are standard riding equipment and are already fitted to the horse.

entries.source: What should children and adults wear?
entries.translation: What should children and adults wear?

entries.source: Long trousers are required to reduce rubbing from the saddle. Wear closed, secure footwear that stays firmly on the foot; riding boots or ankle boots with a small heel are preferred because they help prevent the foot sliding through the stirrup. Flip-flops, slides, backless sandals and loose laces are not permitted. Bring sunscreen, sunglasses and drinking water.
entries.translation: Long trousers are required to reduce rubbing from the saddle. Wear closed, secure footwear that stays firmly on the foot; riding boots or ankle boots with a small heel are preferred because they help prevent the foot sliding through the stirrup. Flip-flops, slides, backless sandals and loose laces are not permitted. Bring sunscreen, sunglasses and drinking water.

entries.source: Professional photo and video services are not included and may be offered separately during the experience.
entries.translation: Professional photo and video services are not included and may be offered separately during the experience.

entries.source: Contact us on WhatsApp to check availability, pickup time, route details, price and what to bring for Horse Riding / Horse Farm.
entries.translation: Contact us on WhatsApp to check availability, pickup time, route details, price and what to bring for Horse Riding / Horse Farm.

entries.source: Participation is subject to the horse club’s final safety assessment. Horse selection, route access, riding format and permission to continue are determined according to the rider’s age, height, weight, balance and experience, as well as horse welfare, equipment fit and current conditions.
entries.translation: Participation is subject to the horse club’s final safety assessment. Horse selection, route access, riding format and permission to continue are determined according to the rider’s age, height, weight, balance and experience, as well as horse welfare, equipment fit and current conditions.

entries.source: Guests must attend the full briefing and follow the instructor during mounting, the trial ride, the route, stops and dismounting. Riding away from the group or ignoring commands is not permitted.
entries.translation: Guests must attend the full briefing and follow the instructor during mounting, the trial ride, the route, stops and dismounting. Riding away from the group or ignoring commands is not permitted.

entries.source: A correctly fitted riding helmet must remain fastened while mounted. Long trousers and closed secure footwear are required; riding or ankle boots with a small heel are preferred. Loose footwear and unsecured items are prohibited.
entries.translation: A correctly fitted riding helmet must remain fastened while mounted. Long trousers and closed secure footwear are required; riding or ankle boots with a small heel are preferred. Loose footwear and unsecured items are prohibited.

entries.source: Approach horses calmly from a visible side, keep a safe distance from other horses and never stand directly behind one. Running, shouting, sudden movements, feeding or touching horses without permission are not allowed.
entries.translation: Approach horses calmly from a visible side, keep a safe distance from other horses and never stand directly behind one. Running, shouting, sudden movements, feeding or touching horses without permission are not allowed.

entries.source: Pregnant guests cannot participate. Riders must disclose relevant health or mobility concerns. The instructor may shorten, change or cancel the route because of weather, terrain, horse condition or rider safety.
entries.translation: Pregnant guests cannot participate. Riders must disclose relevant health or mobility concerns. The instructor may shorten, change or cancel the route because of weather, terrain, horse condition or rider safety.

entries.source: The horse club’s briefing, helmet rules, rider assessment, horse allocation and instructor decisions always take priority over the advertised route, timing and general participation information.
entries.translation: The horse club’s briefing, helmet rules, rider assessment, horse allocation and instructor decisions always take priority over the advertised route, timing and general participation information.
